basic.name: Regrowth
basic.description: Heal an allied Hero for 380~~0.04~~ Health over 20 seconds.

basic.name: Moonfire
basic.description:
Deal 90~~0.04~~ damage to enemies in an area and reveal them for 2 seconds.

Allies with an active Regrowth are healed for 130~~0.04~~ Health for each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire.

basic.name: Entangling Roots
basic.description: Root enemy Heroes in an area for 1.25 seconds, and deal 117~~0.04~~ damage over the duration. Affected area grows over 3 seconds.

heroic.name: Tranquility
heroic.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80~~0.04~~ Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

heroic.name: Twilight Dream
heroic.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310~~0.04~~ damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

trait.name: Innervate
trait.description:
Grant an allied Hero 20% of their maximum Mana over 5 seconds. While affected by Innervate, their Basic Ability cooldowns recharge 50% faster.

Cannot be used on Heroes that do not use Mana.

activable.name: Tenacious Roots
activable.description: When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset.

activable.name: Nature's Cure
activable.description: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

activable.name: Astral Communion
activable.description:
Activate to Channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location. Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream.

Passive: Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

level1.name: Deep Roots
level1.description:
Entangling Roots grows 25% larger, and persist on the ground 40% longer.

Repeatable Quest: Every time an enemy Hero becomes Rooted, gain 14 Mana permanently.

level1.name: Vengeful Roots
level1.description:
Entangling Roots spawns a Treant that deals 58 damage per second and loses Health over 11 seconds.

Repeatable Quest: Hitting enemy Heroes with Entangling Roots permanently increases the Treant's Basic Attack damage by 7.

level1.name: Emerald Dreams
level1.description: Entangling Roots Sleeps enemy Heroes for 2 seconds after its Root expires.

level4.name: Rejuvenation
level4.description: Casting Regrowth on an ally also grants Malfurion its effect for 50% normal duration.

level4.name: Celestial Alignment
level4.description: Increase Moonfire's reveal duration by 3 seconds. Malfurion's Basic Attacks against Heroes revealed by Moonfire deal 85% more damage.

level4.name: Shan'do's Clarity
level4.description: Gain a second charge of Innervate. Its cooldown recharges 25% faster per ally affected by Regrowth.

level7.name: Wild Growth
level7.description: Each Hero hit by Moonfire extends the duration of currently active Regrowths by 1 second.

level7.name: Tenacious Roots
level7.description: Increase the Root duration of Entangling Roots by 25%. When Malfurion is Stunned, the cooldown of Entangling Roots is instantly reset. This can only occur every 10 seconds.

level7.name: Nature's Cure
level7.description: Activate to remove all Stuns, Roots, and Slows from allies affected by Regrowth.

level10.name: Tranquility
level10.description: Heal nearby allied Heroes for 80~~0.04~~ Health per second for 8 seconds. Allies affected by Regrowth within Tranquility's area gain 10 Armor.

level10.name: Twilight Dream
level10.description: After 0.5 seconds, deal 310~~0.04~~ damage in a large area around Malfurion, Silencing enemies making them unable to use Abilities for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Nature's Swiftness
level13.description: Malfurion gains 6% Movement Speed for every active Regrowth.

level13.name: Hindering Moonfire
level13.description: Moonfire Slows Heroes hit by 25% for 3 seconds.

level13.name: Revitalize
level13.description: Using Innervate also grants Malfurion 15% of his max Mana and causes his Basic Ability cooldowns to refresh 50% faster for 5 seconds.

level16.name: Ysera's Gift
level16.description: While Malfurion is above 75% Health, Regrowth's healing-over-time is increased by 75%.

level16.name: Nature's Balance
level16.description: Increase Moonfire's area by 25% and Regrowth's duration by 5 seconds.

level16.name: Moonlit Harmony
level16.description: Increase Moonfire's heal by 20%, and 15% per ally affected by Regrowth.

level20.name: Serenity
level20.description: Each enemy Hero hit by Moonfire reduces the cooldown of Tranquility by 3 seconds. Increase Tranquility's healing by 25% and 10% per ally affected by Regrowth.

level20.name: Astral Communion
level20.description:
Activate to Channel for 1 second, and then instantly teleport and cast Twilight Dream at the targeted location. Cooldown is shared with Twilight Dream.

Passive: Increase Twilight Dream's Silence duration to 5 seconds.

level20.name: Lifebloom
level20.description: Casting Regrowth instantly heals its target for 10% of their missing Health.

level20.name: Lunar Shower
level20.description: If Moonfire hits a Hero, its cooldown is reduced by 1 second and the next Moonfire within 6 seconds deals 20% more damage. This damage bonus stacks up to 60%.
